description: This file defines the SubscriptionNotFoundException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to handle cases where a subscription with a specified ID is not found during operations. It includes methods to create instances from an ID or a JSON object, and maintains metadata like error codes and HTTP status.

classes.name: SubscriptionNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a subscription with the specified ID was not found. Implements methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, and interacts with the Ditto framework's exception hierarchy.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing instances of SubscriptionNotFoundException with a fluent API, marked as not thread-safe.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionNotFoundException for a given subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionNotFoundException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SubscriptionNotFoundException with updated headers.
